dataset.name: SumMe
dataset.license: Videos: not owned by the authors, provided for non-commercial research purposes only. Annotations: free to use for research purposes. Cite Gygli et al., ECCV 2014.

preregistration.primary_split: first 25% of segments by time is seed, rest held out
preregistration.secondary_split: random 25% of segments is seed (content shift not blocked), labeled secondary

arms_added.generic: logistic regression on all users' labels from the other 24 videos, no labels from this video. Logreg replaces TabPFN because the stacked training set (~33k rows) exceeds TabPFN's 10k-row limit. PCA(64) fit on the other videos' embeddings, C=1, no tuning.
arms_added.hybrid: TabPFN on this editor's seed rows with the generic score (probability) as an extra feature

verdict.personal_adds_value: hybrid minus generic at 20% depth, 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 -> PASS, else NULL

unchanged: skip rule: fewer than 3 seed positives

learns_personal_taste.rule: tabpfn minus crowd_oracle (not deployable) at 20% depth, 95% CI lower bound > 0

beats_similarity.rule: tabpfn minus knn at 20% depth, mean >= 0.10

personal_adds_value.rule: hybrid minus generic at 20% depth, 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
